source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Two kinds of unit of yours gain a bonus for the rest of the phase by making a [Dark Pact](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.dark-pacts):

- During your Shooting phase, if a **HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER** unit of yours (not a **DAEMON** unit) is **selected to shoot** and makes a [Dark Pact](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.dark-pacts), its ranged attacks get +1 **S**.
- During any Fight phase, if a **HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON PRINCE** or **DAEMON PRINCE WITH WINGS** unit of yours (not a **KHORNE** unit) is **selected to fight** and makes a [Dark Pact](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.dark-pacts), its melee attacks get +2 **S** and +1 **AP**.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 296 combat readings of Detachment rules (every record of the class not withheld otherwise, each time) wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

detail.durationBasis: core rule 01.02.02 Persisting Rules Effects: the card states no duration, so the effect lasts for the phase in which it was applied
